item.title: Mitsubishi Estate becomes Official Supporter of Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027
item.description: World Rugby today announced Mitsubishi Estate Co., Ltd. as an Official Supporter of Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027, further strengthening the tournament’s growing commercial family ahead of its return to Australia from 1 October to 13 November 2027.

item.title: Media advisory: Rugby World Cup 2027 match schedule reveal
item.description: World Rugby will officially unveil the full match schedule for Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027 in Australia on Tuesday 3 February morning (Australian time). Media and photographers are invited to attend opportunities with key tournament spokespeople and talents in Sydney (main event), Brisbane, Perth, Melbourne, Adelaide and Townsville.
